subject.title: [Bug]: openai-completions fallback candidate is selected, but fallback does not complete successfully through an OpenAI-compatible proxy

question: Should OpenClaw handle the remaining selected OpenAI-compatible proxy fallback failure with a captured-field-specific sanitizer/diagnostic, or should it add and document an explicit strict-minimal completions compatibility mode?
rationale: Source shows several plausible request-shape causes, and adding feature-disabling or strict-minimal configuration would change provider compatibility policy without a captured failing payload proving the narrowest fix.

options.title: Capture Then Target
options.body: Require a redacted failed OpenClaw request body plus proxy status/body, then land only the sanitizer or logging needed for that incompatibility.

options.title: Add Strict-Minimal Mode
options.body: Approve a new provider/model compatibility mode or config knob that intentionally emits a reduced Chat Completions payload for narrow proxies.

options.title: Document Unsupported Narrow Proxies
options.body: Document the current request contract and close future cases unless the proxy supports the required streaming, tools, and request fields.

recommendation.title: Capture Then Target
recommendation.body: Require a redacted failed OpenClaw request body plus proxy status/body, then land only the sanitizer or logging needed for that incompatibility.

likelyOwner.reason: osolmaz is assigned to the live issue and is the clearest current owner for the provider fallback policy choice.
